record.original_question: Given a characteristicp, is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subspaces of some vector space over a field of characteristicpa variety?

evidence.quote: [Wor2024b, quest. 3.92] Given a characteristicp, is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subspaces of some vector space over a field of characteristicpa variety?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p be either a prime number or 0. For each field K of characteristic p and each K-vector space V, let L(V) denote the lattice of all linear subspaces of V (ordered by inclusion, with meet given by intersection and join by sum). Define
  C_p = { L : L is a lattice isomorphic to a sublattice of L(V) for some vector space V over some field of characteristic p }.

A class of lattices is called a variety if it is closed under the formation of homomorphic images, sublattices, and arbitrary direct products; equivalently, by Birkhoff's theorem, if it can be defined by a set of lattice identities.

Decide, for each fixed characteristic p, whether C_p is a variety of lattices.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the class of lattices embeddable into the subspace lattice of some vector space over a field of fixed characteristic p forms a lattice variety appears in collections of open problems on lattice theory and universal algebra. Surveys on varieties of lattices (Jipsen–Rose) and recent surveys discuss the smallest lattice variety containing all such subspace lattices, but the question whether the embeddable class itself is a variety (closed under homomorphic images) appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Varieties of Lattices — Jipsen and Rose
status_evidence.snippet: For each characteristic c (prime or 0), there is a smallest lattice variety V_c containing all lattices of subspaces L(V_F) over division rings of characteristic c.
status_evidence.claim: The smallest lattice variety containing subspace lattices of characteristic c is studied, but whether the class of all sublattices of such lattices is itself a variety is not established.

status_evidence.title: A survey of lattice properties: modular, Arguesian, linear, and distributive
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses lattices embeddable in subspace lattices and related open problems concerning their equational classes.
status_evidence.claim: The status of whether the class of lattices embeddable into subspace lattices over a field of characteristic p is a variety is discussed as an open problem.
